exact_none_branch.chain: next_wakeup_ns() = min(cs_wakeup); cs_wakeup empty because BootstrapPto not pushed because loss.next_time_loss_deadline_ns(..) returned None

exact_none_branch.conclusion: the outstanding work is NOT a future deadline; it is DUE-NOW work (pending_lost) that could not be emitted because the pacer had no tokens. Its next progress instant is governed by source #6, which nothing exposes.
exact_none_branch.existing_pending_work_predicate: cs_has_pending_work() sender.rs:1736 (feature-gated) = tx_queue | pending_lost | dup_queue | pending_fec

binding_contract.must_not_return_none_when: after the documented immediate-output drain, timer-driven outstanding work OR an internal future deadline exists
none_valid_only_when: progress depends solely on external network input
binding_contract.due_now_signal: Some(now) - never a hidden 'poll me again' None
binding_contract.no_busy_loop: Some(now) only while due work actually exists, and cleared once consumed, so a driver that drains then re-queries converges
